jobs.title: Reliever Procurement Associate
jobs.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Procurement Associate (Reliever) to support day-to-day procurement activities. The role will involve reviewing purchase requisitions, evaluating supplier quotations, processing purchase orders, monitoring deliveries, and coordinating with vendors to ensure the smooth execution of procurement transactions. This will be a 4 months contract. The selected candidate will undergo a knowledge transfer and work shadowing period to become familiar with active purchase orders, vendor lists, pending requisitions, and ongoing supplier negotiations. Key Responsibilities Review purchase requisitions to ensure completeness and compliance with procurement requirements. Tabulate and compare supplier offers and quotations to support procurement evaluation. Prepare and issue purchase orders (POs) in accordance with established procurement procedures. Monitor and coordinate the timely delivery of goods and services. Address day-to-day vendor inquiries and coordinate with suppliers to resolve procurement-related concerns. Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure timely follow-through on pending requisitions and purchase orders. Participate in knowledge transfer activities to gain familiarity with ongoing procurement transactions, supplier relationships, and negotiations.

jobs.title: Auto Mechanic
jobs.description: At I&I Automotive Modifications , we don't just fix cars—we elevate them. Specializing in high-end luxury maintenance, performance upgrades, and custom modification builds, our shop operates at the highest standards of automotive excellence. We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Auto Mechanic who takes pride in precision work and loves working on high-performance machinery. What You'll Do Perform thorough inspections and computer-aided diagnostics to accurately identify engine, drivetrain, electronic, and mechanical issues on luxury and performance vehicles. Precision-repair or replace worn, damaged, or upgraded parts to ensure optimal performance, structural integrity, and reliability. Execute high-standard routine maintenance, including synthetic oil, filter, fluid changes, and multi-point safety checks in accordance with OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications. Adjust, align, and calibrate mechanical, suspension, and electronic components—including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and sensors—to strict manufacturer tolerances. Perform comprehensive safety checks and emissions inspections as required. Maintain accurate records of all diagnostic steps, services rendered, and parts utilized to support precise invoicing and customer vehicle history. Collaborate with Project Manager to communicate diagnostic findings, explain complex technical issues, and identify necessary or preventative repair recommendations. Follow detailed work orders, project plans, and technical instructions from leadership; collaborate closely with Project Manager to ensure timeline adherence, regular status updates, and smooth project execution. Work cooperatively with fellow technicians, and Project Manager to communicate diagnostic findings, explain complex technical issues, and address additional repair needs.

jobs.title: Category Analyst
jobs.description: The Category Analyst is crucial in supporting the planning and execution of sales targets, analyzing sales data, coordinating demand planning for new collections, managing inventory effectively, and conducting competitor checks. They work closely with departments such as Sales, Creative, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production, Quality Control, and Distribution to ensure alignment and optimize performance. What you'll do: Target Setting: Assist in setting monthly sales targets based on historical sales trends per month per class category and store performance. Sales Data Analysis: Monitor sell-through of all collections launched within the past six months. Generate monthly sales reports for assigned categories. Demand Planning and Execution for New Collections: Collaborate in proposing collection budgets based on historical sales trends. Assist in planning upcoming collection demand by analyzing class type, sub-class types, sizes, fabric, color, and design/styles. Support in proposing store budgets aligned with the total demand planned for upcoming collections. Assist in allocating inventory to stores and online platforms based on targets. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control departments to ensure the availability of new collections before the launch date. Coordinate with the Distribution Department to align delivery schedules based on allocation. Generate reports comparing transfer orders versus out slips for new collections. Inventory Management: Analyze monthly inventory and three-month average sales to identify Months to Sell (MTS). Facilitate the repeat of available stocks from the warehouse and pull-out from other stores based on demand. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand.
